Die Wikingerstämme leben nebeneinander her, und es sollte eigentlich keinen Grund geben, sich zu bekriegen...

It is the beginning of a new era. The Vikings have settled in a big valley, which will become their new home. There is sufficient space for everyone here. Nobody need fear a lack of resources.
The Viking tribes live peacefully together, and there should be no reason to start a war ...
But reality is different - so go and fight!
